topic: Mastering the Putnam: Strategy and Intuition

sections.title: The Putnam Mindset: Beyond Calculation
lecture_lines: Putnam problems prioritize insight over computation.
Shift your focus toward pattern recognition.
Don't brute-force; look for elegant structures.
animations: Fade in 'Insight' icon using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg] in #FFD700 below it.

sections.title: Prerequisite Toolkit: The Power of Invariants
lecture_lines: Invariants remain constant despite dynamic change.
Use invariants to track system state.
Parity and coloring often reveal hidden answers.

sections.title: Strategic Heuristics: Extreme Principle & Descent
lecture_lines: Consider the most extreme set elements.
Extreme points often force global constraints.
The extreme principle collapses search spaces.
animations: Animate a descent to a minimum in #7B68EE using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mountain.svg].

sections.title: Symmetry and Reduction
lecture_lines: Identify symmetry to reduce problem complexity.
Map multi-variable systems to single representations.
animations: Fold the shape [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/origami.svg] to show reduction in #FF69B4.

sections.title: Putting it Together: The Final Proof Architecture
lecture_lines: Structure your proof clearly and logically.
Recognize hidden patterns to simplify integrals.
Effective storytelling is key to proof architecture.
